style: Apple keynote product sting — pure-black stage, premium minimalism, huge confident grotesque typography with tight tracking, one phosphor-green accent, buttery power4.out ease-outs, subtle glow, product-reveal pacing

customize.note: One full-duration .clip, four scene groups. Reuse-first: four registry components cover every named look; only the glow/caret/hold tweens are hand-authored vocabulary primitives (trivial GSAP, per motion-vocabulary.md).

typed-prompt.caret: solid block caret, #30D158, 32x64px (0.5em x 1em), deterministic blink 0.53s integer cycle, caret rides the typing frontier
typed-prompt.style: bare line, no window chrome, no panel — pure-black stage

focus-blur-resolve.resolve: from { opacity: 0, filter: blur(18px), scale: 0.96 } to crisp, 0.9s, power4.out
focus-blur-resolve.exit_blur: do NOT use the block's blur-out exit — wordmark holds to final frame

motion-blur.axis: horizontal only: SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation (0,0) -> (28,0), one-sided ghost trail
motion-blur.pairing: runs concurrently with focus-blur-resolve entrance so the line appears to become the wordmark

per-word-rise.rise: per-word from { opacity: 0, y: +24, filter: blur(8px) }, 0.6s/word, stagger 0.12s, power4.out, settle soft, no exit

hand_authored_primitives.glow: textShadow tween on the X glyph only (own span): ignite 0 0 0 rgba(48,209,88,0) -> 0 0 60px rgba(48,209,88,0.55); breathe-down to 0 0 40px rgba(48,209,88,0.35); settle to whisper 0 0 18px rgba(48,209,88,0.15)
hand_authored_primitives.hold_breath: wordmark scale 1.0 -> 1.015, sine.inOut, during scene 3; returns to 1.0 by 7.0s
hand_authored_primitives.caret_coda: thin green block caret (26x44px) fades in after final tagline word, one deterministic blink on the 7.0s beat, fades out

typography.family: Inter (single family for the whole piece — terminal read comes from the $ prefix, dim prompt sigil, and green block caret, NOT a second mono font)

wordmark.x_glyph: own span, same styling, carries the glow

tagline.emphasis_word: terminal-based in #F5F5F7 (color-only emphasis — no pulse; Apple calm)

layout.stage: #000000 full-bleed; safe margins 96px sides / 54px top-bottom (5%); everything centered — all elements well inside safe area
layout.prompt_line: centered at (960, 490) — SAME anchor as the wordmark so the blur metamorphosis happens in place
layout.wordmark: centered at (960, 490), baseline ~y=560 (optical center floats above 540 because the tagline sits beneath)
layout.caret_coda_position: immediately after the final tagline word's advance, baseline-aligned

palette_roles.accent: #30D158 (caret + X glow ONLY — never anywhere else)

scenes.emotion: anticipation, precision — a real shell waking up
scenes.motion: typewriter: prompt group fades in at 0.15s (hook lands <0.5s — caret + $ visible by 0.3s); 11 chars type left-to-right at an even 70ms/char (0.30s -> 1.07s), green block caret riding the frontier and blinking on a deterministic 0.53s cycle; on the 1.8s beat the caret pulses once (scale 1->1.15->1, 0.3s sine.inOut, plus a 0 0 24px rgba(48,209,88,0.8) flash) — the command 'executes'; line holds, caret blinking, to 2.4s

THE dominant metamorphosis — the pattern interrupt changes exactly one thing (the line becomes the wordmark). Anticipated 0.1s: at 2.30s the terminal line smears out — motion-blur horizontal-only stdDeviation (0,0)->(28,0), letter-spacing 0->+0.06em, opacity 1->0, 0.55s power2.in, caret fading with it. At 2.40s the wordmark 'karmX' blur-resolves in place from { opacity: 0, blur: 18px, scale: 0.96 } to crisp, 0.9s power4.out — fully legible by 3.4s (legible hold 3.4->8.0 = 4.6s). On the 3.4s beat the capital X ignites its green glow (0.45s sine.out to 0 0 60px rgba(48,209,88,0.55)), then breathes down to 0 0 40px rgba(48,209,88,0.35) by 4.6s
scenes.layout: Inter 800 220px, tracking -0.04em, #F5F5F7, centered at (960, 490); X in its own span carrying the glow

scenes.motion: word_reveal: 4 words rise beneath the wordmark, each from { opacity: 0, y: +24, blur: 8px }, 0.6s/word, stagger 0.12s, power4.out, starting 4.70s — all landed by 5.72s (cascade completes around the 5.4s beat); 'terminal-based' inks in #F5F5F7 against the gray — color-only emphasis, no pulse. Wordmark holds with a barely-there hold_breath (scale 1.0->1.015, sine.inOut, 4.6->6.6s)

glow settle: the X textShadow eases from 0 0 40px rgba(48,209,88,0.35) to a whisper 0 0 18px rgba(48,209,88,0.15), 0.8s power2.inOut (6.6->7.4s); hold_breath returns the wordmark to scale 1.0 by 7.0s. Coda caret: a thin green block (26x44px) fades in after the last tagline word at 6.9s, blinks once on the 7.0s beat (off 7.00->7.08, on 7.13, deterministic steps), fades out 7.3->7.6s. Pure stillness 7.6->8.0 — NO exit tween; hold the final frame
scenes.layout: wordmark + tagline hold their scene-3 positions; coda caret baseline-aligned after 'agent'
